editorial:
Picture this: you are stuck on a seven-hour flight from New York to Paris, and the person sitting right next to you is your ex. That is the simple but fun setup of this French romantic comedy. Antoine is a smooth-talking lawyer heading home for a big job interview, and Julie is the woman he once loved and lost. The movie plays out mostly in the tight space of an airplane cabin, with flashbacks showing how their relationship started, fell apart, and left both of them with unfinished feelings. The vibe is light and playful, with plenty of banter, awkward moments, and sweet memories mixed in. If you enjoy stories about second chances and old flames, this one pulls you in quickly.

The acting is charming, especially the back-and-forth between the two leads, and the pacing keeps things moving with quick jokes and heartfelt beats. On the downside, some jokes feel a bit silly, and a few flashback scenes slow the story down. Still, the chemistry carries the movie, and the ending feels earned. This is a great pick for a cozy date night or a lazy weekend watch. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray if you want the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Antoine finally drops his guard and tells Julie he still loves her. She admits she feels the same, even though she was heading to marry someone else. They share a kiss as the plane lands, and when they reach Paris, Julie calls off her engagement. Antoine skips his interview to be with her, and the two walk off together into the city.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies and second-chance love stories.
